title: Neue Galerie New York

services.name: General Admission
services.desc: Reopening Autumn 2026! Café Sabarsky, Book Store, and Design Shop resume regular hours on October 1. All galleries reopen November 12. Neue Galerie New York is open late to the public on select Fridays from 5 to 8 p.m., offering access to the galleries free of charge. Kindly note that the November 2026 First Friday takes place on Friday, November 13 as the Neue Galerie's special exhibition will not yet be open on Friday, November 6. Please expect to wait in line outside of the museum for entry. Admission will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
